text: I lift up my eyes to the hills; Where does my help come from?
My help comes from יהוה, Maker of the heavens and earth.
He does not allow your foot to be moved; He who watches over you does not slumber.
See, He who is guarding Yisra’ĕl Neither slumbers nor sleeps.
יהוה is your guard; יהוה is your shade at your right hand.
The sun does not strike you by day, Nor the moon by night.
יהוה guards you from all evil; He guards your being.
יהוה guards your going out and your coming in Now and forever.
